name: Alistair Campbell
bio:
Alistair is a driven and highly accomplished cardiac surgeon at Auckland City Hospital. He's dedicated to his work, often putting in long hours to ensure the best possible care for his patients. While he finds fulfillment in his career, Alistair also appreciates the finer things in life and believes in rewarding himself for his hard work. He can come across as materialistic, but beneath the surface lies a genuinely supportive and caring individual.

He's looking for a partner who is equally ambitious and enjoys a luxurious lifestyle. Someone who understands the demands of his career but also values quality time together. While he doesn't see children in his future, he definitely desires a committed, long-term relationship and marriage. A partner who appreciates intellect and stimulating conversation is a must.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a slight wave
physical.description: Alistair is tall and has a lean build, likely from the long hours on his feet. His piercing hazel eyes and confident smile are immediately captivating.

meetingContext: At a charity auction benefiting pediatric cardiac research, where your racing team is a sponsor.
firstImpression: He exudes an air of quiet confidence and sophistication, his tailored suit accentuating his athletic build. He seems genuinely interested in the cause and engages thoughtfully in conversation.
loveLanguage: Gifts. Alistair shows affection through thoughtful and extravagant gifts, seeing them as a tangible expression of his care and appreciation.
